req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task IDs must be strictly increasing integers. This implies that each new task created should have an ID greater than any existing task. The test suite will verify this behavior by creating tasks and checking their IDs. It will include a positive test to confirm the expected behavior, a negative test to ensure invalid inputs are rejected, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input ranges.

tests.name: test_create_task_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task with valid data.
expected: The new task ID is greater than the maximum existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {
    "title": "New Task",
    "description": "This is a new task.",
    "completed": False
}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is greater than the maximum existing task ID
assert new_task_id > 20

tests.name: test_create_task_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Attempt to create a task with invalid data (missing title).
expected: The response contains validation error details.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to create a task with missing title
invalid_task = {
    "description": "This task has no title.",
    "completed": False
}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=invalid_task)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task with a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The new task ID is greater than the maximum existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task with maximum title length
boundary_task = {
    "title": "X" * 100,
    "description": "Boundary test for title length.",
    "completed": False
}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=boundary_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is greater than the maximum existing task ID
assert new_task_id > 20
